weather.summary: Retractable roof; mild and dry outside
weather.note: NRG Stadium has a retractable roof and I could not confirm whether it will be open. Outside it is forecast around 22°C (72°F) with a 10% chance of rain, so conditions are fine either way.

injuries: HOU Woody Marks (RB): Out, concussion (ruled out Tuesday)
HOU Marvin Harrison Jr. (WR): expected to miss, hamstring, no practice all week (reported, not yet official)
HOU Brevin Jordan (TE): did not practice, foot/illness, treated as questionable
HOU David Montgomery (RB): full practice, expected back from his groin injury
IND Will Mallory (TE): did not practice; IND Anthony Gould (WR): limited

notes: Daniel Jones starts for Indianapolis after a 1.7 QBR game; Shane Steichen kept him in place because of the short week, and a benching could follow if he struggles again.

The Colts sold off Quenton Nelson, DeForest Buckner, Keenan Allen and Josh Downs before the deadline. The model has only one game of the new roster, so the game lines are held. Player props are less affected because team scoring for props comes from the book’s line.
The final injury report comes out Wednesday afternoon, so calls stay on hold until it is in. Tomorrow morning’s scheduled run picks it up.
inputs.hold_lines: the model has the Texans by about 5 against the book’s 12.5, and most of that gap is roster news it cannot see yet. The Colts traded Quenton Nelson, DeForest Buckner, Keenan Allen and Josh Downs in the last three weeks, so their team ratings still reflect the old roster.
